name: Leather scrap pouch
description: A small flapped pouch stitched together from leftover pieces of leather, with a loop to hang it from a belt.
notes: Brown, chestnut and tan leather patches laced with rawhide, a flap closed by a bone toggle and a leather belt loop on the back. The model is the pouch standing open at its real size. Its back loop takes a belt, so it mounts on a belt with no slot. A crafted item, so it has no loot economy. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Drop leg bag

The model is the bag standing open at its real size, and the box counts the open thigh loops. It has its own leg straps, so it keeps the thigh slot. Choosing a side has no content field yet. name: Large military rucksack
description: A big olive rucksack with a lid, a pouch on each side and a padded hip belt, covered in webbing for more pouches.
notes: Standing upright, harness on -z and front on +z, rather than laid flat: a pack stands, and its front and side webbing both show in the iso view. Olive drab with dark webbing: a lid with two buckled straps, nine rows of PALS webbing across the front, compression straps and webbing down both sides above a flapped side pouch each, padded shoulder straps and hip belt pads. The model is the bag standing open at its real size, and the box counts the hip belt. Attach points: the upper front is the top half of the front webbing, the lower front its bottom half, and each side point the webbing above that side's pouch; the sides are quicker to reach than the front, which faces away from the wearer. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.
